notes.title: Version 1.0.1Updated!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
Version 1.0.1 is released!

- Relaxed the conditions to skip events (Can be done after defeat as well)
- Takes shorter processing time to skip events now
- Fixed the bug that causes the game to freeze when the X button or start button is mashed during the map menu
- Fixed other minor bugs

notes.title: [Great Ambition of the SLIMES #2] The release date has been set for July 27th
notes.content:
[h3]Fulfill the great ambition of the Slime by taking over humans! Introducing "Great Ambition of the SLIMES" a revolution-based tactical RPG. The release date for the Steam version has been set for July 27, 2023 (Tuesday)! The demo version is now available for download at STEAM NEXT FEST![/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44017686/f597f79f49d9c2735bd072d10632031ce2521785.png[/img]

We are pleased to announce that the release date for the revolution-based tactical RPG "Great Ambition of the SLIMES" (STEAM) has been confirmed for July 27, 2023. Furthermore, the demo version is currently available for download at STEAM NEXT FEST, which started on June 20, 2023.


【ABOUT THIS GAME】
"Make slimes take over humans to fight your battles!"
Here's another tactical simulation game you never knew you needed.

You have slimes under your command.
Yup, the weakest of all monsters, slimes.
No, they aren't any stronger in this game.

But what if they have the ability to occupy human bodies?

Take control of strong knights and warlocks to fight your human enemies!
There are also demons to take care of, so things can get complicated.
Demons can't be taken over, but if you use the humans around you…

You'll find several kinds of slimes, humans and demons in this game.
There are over 20 types of slimes to command, each with their own unique abilities. Teleportation, multiplication, there's even a slime that can melt equipment off your enemies!

Which body will you occupy? How will you fight?
The possibilities are endless.
Humans will try to save their friends whenever a slime tries to occupy them. That could be used as a part of your strategy too.
Using items to transform your slimes into different types will help you in the more challenging battles later in the game.

Lend your wisdom to the slimes and help them take over the world!

notes.title: [Great Ambition of the SLIMES #1] System Introduction!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44017686/5cef66c4ad585bcc283d6729140aa70589ebea97.jpg[/img]

A tiny slime with grand ambitions!
The simulation RPG  [b]"Great Ambition of the SLIMES" [/b] is the latest work from altairworks, following the highly acclaimed "Ambition of the Slimes" and "Slime Tactics"!
In this game, players will engage in intense battles with humans and demons using over 20 different slimes with unique abilities.
One of the key features of this game is the perspective from the slime's point of view, where players can possess enemy bodies and manipulate them to fight against their opponents!
While appearing cute and weak on the surface, this is actually an SRPG with various cunning strategies.
Embark on a quest to achieve the slime's rise to power in the traditional RPG world!

In this[b] #1[/b] edition, we will introduce some of [b]the game's systems![/b]
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
[b][h3]◼︎Absorption[/h3][/b]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44017686/d25dab17a806f43df389a0f5129fdbd913f2b29e.gif[/img]
The main feature of this game is that the slimes can take over humans. First, absorb the humans in the nearby squares!！

[b][h3]◼︎Hijack[/h3][/b]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44017686/ac784c1f73c1a78329bda3767be2938af2cfc266.gif[/img]
The main feature of this game is that the slimes can take over humans. First, absorb the humans in the nearby squares!！

[b][h3]◼︎Barrier during Absorption[/h3][/b]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44017686/1c3ed941a997cad815325b332c7fb31dab19a40a.gif[/img]
Slimes who absorb humans have a barrier that defends them from attacks for a few times. Effectively using this barrier is key.

[b][h3]◼︎Defeat during Absorption[/h3][/b]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44017686/b4d52462b2d279408bf67cc51df252e63fb96ce7.png[/img]
Humans prefer to save their companions from slime absorption. It's risky, but this could be used for strategizing a decoy…
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
This game is scheduled for [b]release in July 2023[/b].
Please add it to your [b]wishlist[/b] and look forward to its release.
